# The Vault

> A free, private Magic: The Gathering collection manager. Each person's collection (imported
> from Dragon Shield) is priced daily from Scryfall, with saved decks, deck coverage and
> sharing. People can connect their own AI agents to their own data.

Everything is private to its owner. Agents act for one person: either through OAuth (the person
signs in and approves the app, nothing to copy) or with a personal access token that person
created (Account → Agents & API in the app). Both can be read-only or read-write, and both can
be revoked (Account → Connected apps for OAuth).

## Connect an agent (MCP)

- MCP server: `/api/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, stateless JSON).
- OAuth (ChatGPT, Claude.ai, any MCP client): add the connector URL `https://<host>/api/mcp`. The
  401 from `/api/mcp` points at `/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/api/mcp`; the server
  metadata is at `/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server`. PKCE S256, the `resource` parameter
  (`https://<host>/api/mcp`), a Client ID Metadata Document URL or `POST /oauth/register` as
  `client_id`, scopes `read` (default) and `write` (the person must tick it). Access tokens last
  an hour; refresh tokens rotate, and a reused one revokes the connection. OAuth tokens work on
  `/api/mcp` only, and can never manage the account.
- Token: header `Authorization: Bearer vault_pat_...`
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http vault https://<host>/api/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer vault_pat_..."`
- Tools:
  - collection: `get_collection_summary`, `search_cards`, `get_card`, `list_sets`,
    `get_collection_stats`, `get_value_history`, `get_acquisition_timeline`
  - decks: `check_decklist`, `parse_decklist`, `list_decks`, `get_deck`, `save_deck`,
    `update_deck`, `delete_deck` (asks first), `get_archidekt_deck`
  - any card, owned or not: `lookup_cards`
  - imports, exports and sharing: `list_imports`, `get_import`, `import_collection_csv` (preview first),
    big files: `start_collection_upload`, `get_staged_upload`, `confirm_staged_upload`,
    (Dragon Shield, Moxfield or generic CSV), `list_export_formats`, `list_shared_with_me`,
    `get_shared_deck`, `list_my_shares`, `accept_share`, `stop_sharing` (asks first)
  - connection check: `whoami` (who you are, your scopes, and which data versions the Vault holds)
  - rules and cards, from the Comprehensive Rules and Oracle data: `get_card_oracle`, `get_rulings`,
    `search_rules`, `get_rule`, `verify_citation`, `present_steps`
  - deck analysis, computed by the Vault: `deck_stats`, `deck_legality`, `find_upgrades`,
    `validate_deck_changes`, `find_combos`, `shopping_list`
- MCP prompts (`prompts/list`): `rules_judge`, `explain_interaction`, `upgrade_deck`, `shopping_help`.
- A read-only token doesn't list the write tools; all of the above are read-only.

## How to answer (rules, cards, decks)

- Never answer a rules or card question from memory: call `get_card_oracle` and `get_rulings`, then
  `search_rules` / `get_rule`, and say which rule number and rules edition (`version`) you used.
- Quote only what a tool returned, and check a quote with `verify_citation` before presenting it as an
  official rule, ruling or card text. If the sources don't settle a question, say so.
- Every result has `provenance`. Repeat it: Scryfall's and Wizards' material is theirs, never the
  Vault's; `computed` results were worked out by the Vault from the sources listed in `inputs`.
  Show the Fan Content notice (below) with rules and card text.
- Roles ("ramp", "removal") are Scryfall Tagger tags, a community's opinion. Popularity (EDHREC rank) is
  not power. Prices are dated and come from Scryfall, not from a store.
- Budgets and legality are enforced by the Vault: call `validate_deck_changes` before presenting a list of
  swaps and present it only if `valid` is true. The Vault never contacts stores or fills carts;
  `shopping_list` gives a list to paste into a store's own tool.

## Or use the HTTP API directly

- Start at `GET /api/v1` and follow `_links`. The OpenAPI description is at `/api/openapi.json`,
  and the interactive docs are at `/api/docs`.
- Lists are pages: `{"items", "count", "total", "_links": {"next"}}`. Follow `next`; at most
  500 items per page. Never expect one huge answer.
- Send `If-None-Match` with a response's `ETag`; you get `304` while nothing changed.
  `GET /api/v1/collection` has a `version` that changes whenever the data does.
- Retries: GETs are safe to repeat. For POSTs, send `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>`, and a repeat
  returns the first answer (`Idempotent-Replayed: true`) instead of doing the work twice.
  After a 429 or 503, wait for `Retry-After`.
- Errors are `application/problem+json`: `{"title", "status", "detail"}`. A 403 with
  `insufficient_scope` means the token is read-only.
- Move a collection between apps: `POST /api/v1/imports` accepts Dragon Shield, Moxfield and
  generic CSV. `GET /api/v1/collection/exports` lists the export formats (Dragon Shield,
  Moxfield, Archidekt, generic CSV, text), each downloadable at `/api/v1/collection/export/{format}`.
- Useful endpoints:
  - `/api/v1/collection/cards?sort=-value&limit=25`
  - `/api/v1/collection/cards?q=bolt`
  - `POST /api/v1/decks/coverage {"text": "1 Sol Ring\n4 Lightning Bolt"}`
  - `POST /api/v1/cards/lookup {"identifiers": [{"name": "Rhystic Study"}]}` (any card, up to 75)

## Credit

Card data, images and prices come from Scryfall (https://scryfall.com). When you show card
images, name the artist and Scryfall, and don't crop the images. The Vault is unofficial Fan Content permitted under
the Fan Content Policy, not approved or endorsed by Wizards. Portions of the materials used are
property of Wizards of the Coast. ©Wizards of the Coast LLC.

## Analytics (computed by the Vault)

- `GET /api/v1/collection` includes P&L: `pnl`, `pnl_pct`, `known_cost_paid`, `known_cost_market`,
  `known_cost_copies`, `unknown_cost_copies`. Only copies with a recorded price paid count.
- `GET /api/v1/collection/breakdowns`: by colour identity, main type, mana value, rarity, colour x type.
- `GET /api/v1/collection/valuation`: value, cost and gain by purchase month, peak month, last 12 months.
- `GET /api/v1/collection/names?sort=-value&limit=50`: the collection rolled up by card name (top N).
- `GET /api/v1/collection/sets?q=&sort=release`: each set has its colour mix.
- `POST /api/v1/collection/refresh` (write scope): today's prices from Scryfall, 300 printings per call;
  repeat with the returned `cursor` until `remaining` is 0.
- MCP tools: `get_collection_breakdowns`, `get_valuation`, `list_card_names`, `refresh_prices`.
- [Connect an assistant, step by step](/connect.html)
- [Skills and the plugin](https://github.com/colombod-personal/the-vault/blob/main/docs/skills.md)
